name: Cause & Effect Pedals (CE Pedals)
notes: Mark Roberts and Brian Alexson; design began in fall 2008, first FET Dream shipments March 2009. Indexed catalog is only one documented product, so no larger catalog assumed.

name: Chellee Guitars
notes: Odelya design began early 2009 and was documented in 2010. Later Odie products are separate later-era catalog records, not retroactively assigned to 2010.

name: RPG Electronics
notes: Blue Flame was made for Blue Flame Music; physical production identity is not yet sufficiently documented.

name: RWL Electronics
notes: Two years of experimentation are documented before the 2010 catalog publication; geography and broader catalog need follow-up.

name: Viva Analog
notes: Jean-Charles Maillet; history predates boutique-wave period substantially, but spring 2012 is a clear catalog expansion point for pro-grade DIY effect kits. Distinguish kits from completed pedals.

name: Castledine Electronics
dirt_evidence: Supa Fuzz MkI; MkOne Bender; Magical Mystery Box
notes: Stuart Castledine. Preserve his vintage-style Tone Bender/Supa Fuzz work as revival/recreation lineage separate from original Sola Sound/Marshall manufacture.

name: Buffalo FX
dirt_evidence: Fuzz Face Ge; Germanium Fuzz; CVIII; 18V Power Booster; Evolution
notes: Strong early catalog with explicit limited V1 and later transistor-generation states on Germanium Fuzz. Exact company founding date remains unresolved in this batch.

name: Enormous Door FX
dirt_evidence: ATX Dynamic Overdrive; ICBM / SCUD Fuzz
notes: Austin, Texas. ICBM is documented as the original version later renamed SCUD Fuzz after a trademark conflict. Preserve naming transition.

name: Vertex
dirt_evidence: Dynamic Distortion; later Vertex dirt catalog
notes: Dynamic Distortion is an early indexed dirt anchor from Feb 2014; full early catalog chronology and any predecessor/modification business should be researched separately.

name: Champ Electronics
notes: John Chambers, Nottingham. 2009 TreBoost Plus documentation and 2011 interview establish in-house hand-built, hand-wired production and made-to-order terms. Treble boost is retained as dirt-adjacent historical scope.

name: Plugged It!
dirt_evidence: Ge Fuzz; Fuzz Lab; Dual Distortion; Green Box
notes: 2009 catalog discovery includes several dirt products. Physical identity/geography and full catalog require reconciliation before canonical promotion.
